read.thesis: Standalone Q4 EBITDA margin hit 25.1% and FY26 revenue rose 31.9% to INR506 crores, but management gave no volume data, flagged a currency-driven margin tailwind, and guided margins flat; bracelet utilisation is 75-80%.

utilisation.quote: Capacity utilization on the capacity that was existing was about 75% to 80% this year.

capex.quote: we have planned capex of approximately INR50 crores across businesses during FY27.
